5744-5913-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
5744-5913-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Roshan, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Pinnacle Monk token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1365-2198-2527-5147-5294.easyPrerequisites:
Deceiver Exarch doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Vohar doesn't have summoning sickness.
1365-2198-2527-5147-5294.description:
Activate Vohar's first ability by tapping it.
Vohar triggers, giving creatures you control that share a creature type with it +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Vohar ability from step 1, causing you to loot.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Deceiver Exarch.
When Deceiver Exarch dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Deceiver Exarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Deceiver Exarch persist until end of turn.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Deceiver Exarch.
When Deceiver Exarch dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Deceiver Exarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Vohar.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4474-6255--52.easyPrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4474-6255--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Zahur triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

728-6972-7509.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Gleeful Arsonist
When Gleeful Arsonist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Gleeful Arsonist
When Gleeful Arsonist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Grimgrin abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
728-6972-7509.notes: If Gleeful Arsonist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

728-2558-3490-5231.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Repeat.

710-2961-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, False Demise triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
710-2961-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

826-3310-7855.notablePrerequisites: You are able to put a counter on War Elemental.
826-3310-7855.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling by tapping it, causing War Elemental to gain all creature types until end of turn.
Put a counter on War Elemental.
The Great Goblin's first ability triggers, as War Elemental is a Goblin, Orc and Army due to Amoeboid Changeling, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
War Elemental triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.

1619-3967-4605-5542-6145.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-3967-4605-5542-6145.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Passageway Seer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Passageway Seer enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Passageway Seer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Passageway Seer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Passageway Seer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Passageway Seer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Passageway Seer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Passageway Seer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-3967-4605-5542-6145.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-3192-6972.easyPrerequisites: The number of red creatures you control excluding Ulasht plus the number of green creatures you control excluding Ulasht is at least X.
997-3192-6972.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Ulasht.
When Ulasht dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

3967-7084-7316.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
3967-7084-7316.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Rat King and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Rat King trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2034-6972-7160.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Arcbound Whelp.
When Arcbound Whelp dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Whelp's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Whelp from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

1115-2440-7108-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Sokka's second ability and each Ally you control's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve all prowess triggers, giving each Ally you control +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Sokka trigger, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Ally you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1115-2440-7108-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if you control another Ally.

2893-3875-4136-4826.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When the basic land enters, Tireless Provisioner and Roaring Earth trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Roaring Earth trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

512-1606-4241.notablePrerequisites: You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {W}{W}.
512-1606-4241.description:
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Halo Fountain to become a creature.
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping the lands.
Activate Halo Fountain's second ability by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and then untapping it and Ley Weaver, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2044-4050-6972.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Peema Outrider.
When Peema Outrider dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Peema Outrider enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2821-3821-4183.easyPrerequisites: You control up to four lands excluding Minamo that can tap to produce at least {U}{U}{R}.
2821-3821-4183.description:
Activate up to four lands except Minamo by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}{R}.
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake with haste.
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping Minamo and up to four other lands.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Saheeli.
Repeat.

3372-4264-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Altered Ego
3372-4264-5466.description:
Activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Rakdos Joins Up to become a creature.
Cast Altered Ego by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Altered Ego into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Altered Ego's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Altered Ego's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent and causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve Altered Ego's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 3.

586-1796-2292-5258-5618.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {1}
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

193-1306-3604.description:
Cast Aminatou by paying {W}{U}{B}.
When Aminatou enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Cadric trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Aminatou.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Mana Crypt.
Activate the token Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking the nontoken Aminatou.
Repeat from step 2.
193-1306-3604.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can blink other permanent(s) instead. If those permanents are legendary, you can copy them via Cadric.

1308-5437-5742-5743.description:
Activate Prognostic Sphinx by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Prognostic Sphinx ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2067-5960.notablePrerequisites: Arabella does not have summoning sickness.
2067-5960.description:
Cast Storm Herd by paying {8}{W}{W}, creating a number of 1/1 Pegasus creature tokens equal to your life total.
Declare Arabella as an attacker.
Arabella triggers, dealing damage to each opponent equal to the number of creatures you control with power 2 or less, and causing you to gain life equal to that same number.

190-953-1371-3384.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, targeting Thought Reflection.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to copy Fractured Identity.
Resolve each opponent's Fractured Identity.
Resolve your Fractured Identity, exiling Thought Reflection and causing each opponent to create a copy of it.
Cast Enter the Infinite by paying {8}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to copy Enter the Infinite.
Resolve the first opponent's Enter the Infinite, causing the opponent to draw cards equal to twice their deck size, and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.
Repeat step 7 for each other opponent.

1512-1636-2284.description:
Activate Glare of Subdual by tapping Stonybrook Schoolmaster, targeting Stonybrook Schoolmaster.
Stonybrook Schoolmaster triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk Wizard creature token.
The Merfolk Wizard enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Glare of Subdual ability, tapping Stonybrook Schoolmaster.
Stonybrook Schoolmaster triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk Wizard creature token.
The Merfolk Wizard enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2700-3374-4659.description:
Activate Antler Skulkin by paying {2}, giving Arcbound Shikari persist until end of turn.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Arcbound Shikari, adding {C}{C}.
When Arcbound Shikari dies, its modular and persist abilities trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting all +1/+1 counters on Arcbound Shikari onto another artifact creature you control.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Shikari from your graveyard to the battlefield with one +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
When Arcbound Shikari enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other artifact creature you control.
Repeat.

507-1271-3673-3765.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one other sorcery card in hand.
You are able to cast the additional sorcery.
507-1271-3673-3765.description:
Activate Scroll Rack by paying {1} and tapping it, exiling Worldfire from your hand face down, then causing you to draw one card and put Worldfire on top of your library.
Cast any sorcery spell from your hand by paying its mana cost.
Possibility Storm and Guttersnipe trigger.
Resolve the Possibility Storm trigger, exiling the sorcery spell, then exiling Worldfire from the top of your library and casting it without paying its mana cost.
Guttersnipe triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Resolve Worldfire,  exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to one.
Resolve the Guttersnipe trigger from step 3, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Each opponent loses the game due to having less than zero life.

914-2232-4033-4980.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2232-4033-4980.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Basking Rootwalla from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Anje by tapping it and discarding Basking Rootwalla into exile.
Basking Rootwalla's madness ability and Anje trigger.
Resolve the Basking Rootwalla trigger, causing you to pay {0} to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Basking Rootwalla enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Anje trigger from step 6, untapping it.
Resolve the Anje ability from step 5, causing you to draw a card.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat.
